UI_optionscreen_binding_PersonalKnoxReca: Recall companions: stop tasks and follow
UI_PersonalKnox_SpeechHint: Enable this addon’s world reactions, needs and command replies. Commands still work when speech is off. Does not control speech from Knox or other addons.
UI_PersonalKnox_DiagnosticsHint: Show NPC/barricade and elevation checks in interaction menus. Off by default. Checks run on request; addon errors are still logged.
UI_PersonalKnox_AutoMedicHint: Bandages bleeding and takes painkillers for severe pain. Does not replace manual care and never uses items you do not have.
UI_PersonalKnox_AutoDrinkHint: Drinks from a suitable source in the inventory when thirsty. Pauses between actions and stops in combat or danger.
UI_PersonalKnox_AutoEatHint: Eats suitable food when hungry. Does not take food from the world, avoids rotten or dangerous food, and stops in combat or danger.
UI_PersonalKnox_InfiniteDurabilityHint: Restores the condition of weapons in your hands. Does not repair vehicles or ordinary items.
UI_PersonalKnox_InfiniteAmmoHint: Tops up ammo and magazines for the weapon in your hands; reloading stays normal. Ammo weight is not removed.
UI_PersonalKnox_AutoUnstickHint: If a following companion has not moved for 20 seconds and the player is more than 4 tiles away, the addon recalls it with the native follow command. Working, sleeping or fighting NPCs are left alone.
UI_PersonalKnox_CareSearchBags: Search bags for food and bandages
UI_PersonalKnox_CareSearchBagsHint: Auto-care and auto-eat look for suitable items in worn bags as well as the main inventory. A found item is moved to the main inventory with the native transfer action first.
UI_PersonalKnox_HelpFrequencyHint: How often companions get into situations where help is needed. Scenarios are still in development; the value is saved and the first scenario will use it.
UI_PersonalKnox_NpcVoicesHint: Short native vocalizations with dialogue: warning, pain, generic voice. Text remains; other mods’ lines are not played.
UI_PersonalKnox_NpcNeedRateHint: How fast companions get hungry, thirsty and tired: very slow, slow, normal, fast or very fast, like the game sandbox.
UI_PersonalKnox_ChatterFrequencyHint: How often companions start a conversation: off, rare, normal or often.
UI_PersonalKnox_PerformanceModeHint: Disables background chatter, negotiations and help calls to reduce load. Manual actions stay available.
UI_PersonalKnox_NpcItemAsksHint: A hungry or thirsty companion asks a squadmate; a fed companion shares if they have a spare.
UI_PersonalKnox_AutoReloadHint: Automatically reload the weapon in your hands with the native action when the magazine is not full and ammo is available.
UI_PersonalKnox_ReloadModeHint: Standard — manual only; automatic — reload when the magazine is not full; never — leave the weapon as is.
UI_PersonalKnox_AmmoModeHint: Normal — finite supply; infinite reserve — ammo/magazines are replenished, reload still needed; infinite magazine — magazine is always full, no reload.
UI_PersonalKnox_AmmoInfiniteReload: Infinite reserve, reload only when empty
UI_PersonalKnox_NpcSearchContainersHint: A wounded companion without a bandage searches nearby cabinets/crates for a clean bandage, then bandages.
UI_PersonalKnox_NpcBandageStockHint: Keep 5 bandages in inventory: after battle take them from cabinets and rip zombie clothing.
UI_PersonalKnox_NpcStock: Companions keep food and water reserves
UI_PersonalKnox_NpcStockHint: Keep 2 food portions, 2 water containers and a can opener; refill from nearby cabinets before need.
